description: Question set for the /census acceptance benchmark. Every question is phrased STRUCTURALLY (no person, company or deal is named) so this file routes to the public engine and so the set resolves on any HEADING OS workspace, not only the one it was written on. Ground truth is computed by scripts/utils/census_oracles.py, never by a model.

question_class.traversal: The answer requires visiting many files. A retrieval ceiling below 1.0 here is evidence that top-K cannot carry the answer, which is the case /census is proposed for.
question_class.cross_source: The answer is a set relation between two small, dense files. The ceiling will sit near 1.0 and says only that retrieval is not the bottleneck; a wrong answer at ceiling 1.0 localises the failure to reasoning, where SRLM (arXiv:2603.15653) warns a traversal primitive HURTS.
question_class.control_note: A control's answer must be LITERALLY WRITTEN in the file that constitutes it. Set-extremum questions (most recent, longest untouched, most linked-to) are aggregation in disguise: no file states that it holds the extremum. That error scored the group 0.500 on 2026-08-13 while the two genuine controls scored 1.00 each. A control's truth must also have cardinality exactly 1: 'find every file carrying marker X' is traversal again once X sits in more than one file, measured 1.00 / 1.00 / 1.00 for the cardinality-1 controls against 0.50 and 0.17 for the two that returned sets.

questions.question_ru: Сколько активных тредов не двигалось больше 30 дней, и какие именно
questions.question_en: How many active threads have not moved in over 30 days, and which ones

questions.question_ru: Какие компании из pipeline не упоминаются ни в одном активном треде
questions.question_en: Which pipeline companies are mentioned in no active thread
questions.not_scored_because: The question does not state how to ENUMERATE the pipeline table rows or the people bullets, so oracle and traversal cannot converge on a rule neither was given. Diagnosed 2026-08-13: the three disagreements are 66 vs 19, 51 vs 1, 74 vs 13, none of them about traversal. The retrieval CEILING for this class stays measured and reported - it is the evidence for the Non-Goal - but /census is not graded on it.
